_doc: THE place to change a voice. Edit describe/seed/refText of one character and run `npm run voice`: its reference is re-designed and only its lines are regenerated. Or audition: `npm run voice:cast -- <char> --audition 5`, then `--pick N`. Keep `describe` as short as possible: attributes only (gender, age, pitch, accent, `whispering`), never delivery or emphasis. Emphasis = the stressed word in UPPERCASE in the line's `spoken` (subtitle `text` unchanged). The line `note` is NOT given to the model; it only selects a variant (`match`) / fx rule. VARIANTS (`variants.<name>`, chosen by `speaker: "char:name"` or a `match` word in the note): a variant with its own describe/seed/refText is a DESIGNED reference (every whisper: the character's short description + `whispering`, a whispered sentence) — the model really whispers, lines are cloned from it; audition/swap with `npm run voice:cast -- tomas:whisper --audition 6` then `--pick N` (one command installs it; `npm run voice` then regenerates only those lines). A variant with neither describe nor derive uses the base reference and only changes knobs/level/fx (tomas:breathless: delivery written into `spoken`). `derive` (DSP whisper from the base clip) is legacy — it sounded robotic. See tools/voice/README.md.

choir.name: CHOIR
choir.refText: We are glad you are awake, Technician. Everything is in order. Please, take your time. We will wait for you.
choir.why: calm, very steady male-ish voice (F0 ~180 Hz, the most consistent clone of the audition); the run-time choir chain layers it with copies shifted −5/+4/−12 semitones (formants move too), so it reads plural and androgynous

tomas.name: TOMAS
tomas.refText: Okay, okay, sorry, I'm talking too fast again. It's just been a really long night down here, you know?

whisper.describe: male, young adult, moderate pitch, whispering
whisper.refText: Okay. Stay low, and keep quiet. They can hear us in here. Just keep walking, slowly. Don't look at them.
whisper.why: DESIGNED whisper (2026-11-16, measurement only, nobody listened): audition 2 of voice/auditions/tomas.whisper. Samples voiced 0.42, HNR -1.6 dB, centroid 2555 Hz (old DSP-derived takes: 0.55 / -0.5 dB / 976 Hz), envelope similarity to his normal voice 0.70 (old derived 0.69; his own normal lines 0.81; other cast 0.25-0.53). Runner-ups: 10 ('male, young adult, whispering' seed 2: env 0.67, voiced 0.54) and 8 (seed 8: env 0.61). The short 'male, young adult, whispering' failed ASR on 3 of 4 seeds (too faint).

breathless.why: base reference (no designed or derived clip): the model has no breath control, so the line's `spoken` carries it — [sigh] (the package's only exhale tag) and '...' pauses; speed 1.0 instead of Tomas's 1.1 leaves room for them. Measured on l2_tomas_fit_after_1 (2 seeds): [sigh]+pauses gave up to 4 pauses / 1.3 s and voiced 0.80 vs plain 1-2 pauses / 0.3-0.5 s, voiced 0.84-0.96; ASR 1.0.

tomas.why: light young male (median F0 ~190 Hz); speed 1.1 = 10% less audio length than the duration estimate: he talks too fast. Measured 2026-11-12 on 12 of his lines × 2 seeds: errors 8 vs 9 at 1.0 (not worse).

hale.name: D. HALE
hale.refText: This is Hale. It's late, I haven't slept, and the line is still running. Write this down, whoever finds it.

whisper.refText: It's Hale. Keep your voice down, they're right outside. Listen to me. Write this down, and don't stop.
whisper.why: DESIGNED whisper, measurement only: audition 12 of voice/auditions/hale.whisper ('female, middle-aged, whispering' seed 4): voiced 0.36, HNR -2.1 dB, centroid 2192 Hz, envelope similarity to her normal voice 0.82 (her own normal lines 0.84). Pitch words dropped: the shorter description whispered more AND stayed closer to her (the 'very low pitch' versions: voiced 0.49-0.79, env 0.07-0.70). Runner-ups: 10 (seed 2, env 0.78) and 9 (seed 1, most whispered: voiced 0.28, env 0.71).

hale.why: dark, low, tired (F0 ~184 Hz, darkest spectrum of the auditions)

voss.name: VOSS
voss.refText: Security, Voss speaking. Cameras three and four are down again. I'm logging it, and then I'm going to go and look.
voss.why: young, low, clipped security officer (F0 ~235 Hz)

anand.name: DR. ANAND
anand.refText: Try to stay still for me. You took a bad shock, but your pulse is steady. Breathe slowly. Good. That's it.
anand.why: gentle older man (F0 ~163 Hz, dark); 'elderly, moderate pitch' auditions came out at ~200 Hz and were rejected

okafor.name: OKAFOR
okafor.refText: Line two is running sweet tonight. Mind the step there, my knee's not what it was. The tea is on, if you want some.
okafor.why: lowest male voice of the cast (F0 ~137 Hz), kind

unit.name: UNIT
unit.refText: Good evening. Thank you for your patience. Please remain where you are. A member of staff will be with you shortly.
unit.why: Flat automated voice (2026-11-16, measurement only): audition 33 of voice/auditions/unit ('female, moderate pitch, monotone' seed 3, the old polite refText). 'monotone' is a free word the model responds to (lower, steadier voices); measured on 6 unit lines: F0 sd 2.26-2.33 semitones vs 2.41 for the old voice, HNR 12.0 vs 10.1 dB (steadier phonation), F0 ~291 Hz, distinct from every voice (max envelope similarity 0.30, Voss). Clipped or run-on reference texts were LESS flat (2.6-4.6 st); sampler temperature / guidance changed nothing. Runner-ups: 22 ('female, monotone' seed 1: the flattest, 1.99-2.18 st, but 195 Hz and envelope 0.85 to Hale = sounds like her) and 39 (seed 9: 2.37 st, lowest level variation 5.33 dB).

foreman.name: FOREMAN
foreman.why: three staff voices at once, out of sync (each layer is a real take in that character's voice)

halvorsen.name: HALVORSEN
halvorsen.describe: male, middle-aged, moderate pitch, british accent
halvorsen.refText: Facilities, Halvorsen. I have the schedule open in front of me. It's all in order, as far as I can see. Please, sit down.

whisper.refText: Please, keep your voice down. They're just outside the door. Take it, and go. Go now, while you can.
whisper.why: DESIGNED whisper, measurement only: audition 17 of voice/auditions/halvorsen.whisper ('male, middle-aged, british accent, whispering' seed 5): voiced 0.46, HNR -1.2 dB, centroid 1741 Hz, ASR 1.00 - the most whispered of the 12 accent candidates. Envelope similarity is not informative for him (his own normal lines only 0.37 to his reference). Runner-ups: 16 ('male, middle-aged, whispering' seed 4, no accent word: voiced 0.49, env 0.25) and 9 (accent, seed 1: voiced 0.55).

halvorsen.why: STAGE 3a, picked by measurement only (nobody listened): British accent, F0 ~113 Hz, centroid ~2475 Hz = far from CHOIR (180) and every other voice; crisp = bureaucratic. Whisper variant derived (match 'whisper'). Runner-ups: auditions 9, 6 (voice/auditions/halvorsen).

reyes.name: REYES
reyes.refText: I came up from Line Two. I haven't slept. I need a phone, and I need it now.
reyes.why: STAGE 3a, measurement only: F0 ~152 Hz, centroid ~2199 Hz; 3 lines. Hoarseness cannot be measured. Runner-ups: auditions 2, 3 (voice/auditions/reyes).

resident.name: RESIDENT
resident.refText: Hello? Sorry to bother you. I think there's something wrong with the door. Can you hear me?
resident.why: STAGE 3a, measurement only: 'high pitch' (plan said moderate) because moderate came out at 246-271 Hz = Voss/Unit. F0 ~314 Hz. Heard through the door low-pass. Runner-ups: auditions 4, 1 (voice/auditions/resident).

_fx: Run-time processing names (src/audio/voice.ts): clean, choir (choir:N = N layers), intercom, headset (alias radio), unit, recorder, pa, foreman. Resolution: line.fx > first matching fxRules entry (id regex / note substring) > variant fx > character fx.
